what: At first the Hero is covered by a background-colored window Frame (30vw top and bottom, 82dvh borders left and right) with only the center logo visible. At 1.8s the logo changes and the Frame peels away over 2.5s on a three-part Curve (ease → sharp brake cubic-bezier(.7,.02,.85,.1) → soft opening cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)). The scene inside (photo) is transparent at .8x for 4 seconds, rises to 1x over 2 seconds, then slowly grows to 1.1x. At 4s the second logo disappears in .4s, and at 4.2s the Hero copy and buttons turn on over 1 second. On phones it is 90vw top and bottom and 28dvh left and right, in two parts (ease → cubic-bezier(.55,.085,.68,.53)).

options.delay: When the window frame starts to clear (s, from load), default 1.8
options.dur: Seconds until the window frame fully clears, default 2.5
options.grow: Duration (s) for the scene to fade in and scale up to 1.1x, default 4
options.out: When the second logo starts to disappear (sec), default 4 · out-dur default .4
options.reveal: Time (sec) when reveal children turn on, default 4.2 · reveal-dur default 1
options.lock: If on, scrolls to the top and locks scrolling until the reveal (original), default off
options.--fx-frame-y · --fx-frame-x: Frame thickness top/bottom and left/right (css), default 30vw · 82dvh. On phones (under 768px) it is --fx-frame-y-phone · --fx-frame-x-phone (90vw · 28dvh)
options.[data-fx-part=scene]: Scene that rises and grows (child) — holds the photo, window frame and second logo
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Window frame to be lifted (inside scene, empty element)
options.[data-fx-part=mark] · [data-fx-part=mark: (Optional) First logo · second logo shown while the window frame lifts away (inside scene)
options.[data-fx-part=reveal]: (Optional, multiple) text and buttons that turn on after everything has opened
options.fx:open · fx:done: When the window frame starts to lift · event rising from the element when reveal turns on

note: The original uses CSS keyframes (a different curve per segment), so the part was ported to CSS keyframes too. It holds the Hero for 4.2 seconds, so on screens that are skipped often, shorten the delay and reveal.
